Inspection / Maintenance Item: Are compressors free of corrosion or other damage?
Are compressor pads and/or foundations in good condition and properly supporting the compressors?
Are base plate bolts in place and securing the compressor to that foundation?
Is the crankcase oil properly filled?
Is the crankcase oil pressure properly set?
Has the oil filter been changed at the manufacturer's recommended interval?
Are strainers elements in good working condition (i.e., strainer screens free of debris) and leak-free?
Are pressure relief valves installed in the appropriate location and in good working condition?
Are all stainless steel flex connectors in good working condition (i.e., reinforcement braid is not damaged)?
Are all back check valves in proper working condition and leak-free?
Are fittings and piping associated with the compressor leak-free?
Are drive belts properly aligned, tension properly set, and in good working condition?
For direct drive compressors, are shaft couplings properly aligned and in good working condition?
Are drive belt guards in place and secure?
Are pressure gauges (suction and discharge) in good condition (i.e., 0 - 400 psig)?
